selection: Existing 284 dayside solar-wind PCW events; retain explicit no_intersection only. Unavailable never counted as no intersection.
geometry: Paired event-sample mean position and 0.01 Hz low-pass B0; 5-degree AVSO; infinite straight line in both B directions; 3D conic physical branch.

bow_shock_model.name: martinecz_2008_solar_minimum
bow_shock_model.note: Three-parameter VEX/ASPERA-4 fit in 5-degree aberrated VSO coordinates.

inversion: User-requested convention: n_H=fcp*n_Hplus/(Phi*nu), Phi=80; no 2pi numerator. Same background subtraction, phi_index=0.30, FD approximation and other parameters.
accumulation_time_convention: tau=Phi/fcp, so Phi=fcp*tau counts gyroperiods; prior Phi=Omega_cp*tau used angular phase. New tau/old tau=2*pi*80/200.
fit: Direct equal-event-weight least squares of log density; ALL individual events, no median binning or altitude weights. Chamberlain sources 1+2+3a, exobase250km, T200–50000K.
uncertainty: 300 observation-day cluster bootstrap draws within each group, seed2026; direct refit each draw; conditional statistical 95% percentile intervals.
display: Logarithmic surface-altitude axis, Rv units, upper limit10Rv. Events above10Rv remain in the fit.
